# RecipeTable

Table of typed columns whose rows the operator edits: recipes, setpoint tables (IND-113, IND-114).

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.RecipeTable(
    value=[
        {"step": "Heat", "temp": 65, "time": 30, "agitator": "slow", "vacuum": False},
        {
            "step": "React",
            "temp": 82.5,
            "time": 120,
            "agitator": "fast",
            "vacuum": True,
        },
        {"step": "Cool", "temp": 30, "time": 45, "agitator": "slow", "vacuum": False},
    ],
    label="RecipeTable",
    row_edit=True,
    max_rows=20,
    columns=[
        {"name": "step", "type": "text"},
        {
            "name": "temp",
            "title": "Temperature",
            "unit": "°C",
            "min": 20,
            "max": 90,
            "step": 0.5,
            "format": "%.1f",
        },
        {
            "name": "time",
            "title": "Hold",
            "unit": "min",
            "min": 0,
            "max": 240,
            "step": 1,
            "format": "%.0f",
        },
        {"name": "agitator", "type": "choice", "choices": ["off", "slow", "fast"]},
        {"name": "vacuum", "type": "bool"},
    ],
    size=(560, 150),
)
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | array | `[560,220]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `columns` | array of object | `[]` | host | Columns {name, title, type, unit, min, max, step, format, choices, readonly, default}. Python normalizes them (a string is a number column of that name, missing keys get their defaults) and rejects duplicate names, unknown keys, max < min and choice columns without choices. |
| `value` | array of object | `[]` | host, widget | Rows, each a dict keyed by column name, every cell valid for its column. Written by the host (Python checks every row); operator edits arrive as messages and are applied by the host, or by the front end when no host owns the state (HOST-012). |
| `row_edit` | boolean | `false` | host | Let the operator add and delete rows (IND-114). |
| `max_rows` | integer | `100` | host | Most rows the table may hold. |
